scope.flow: Withdrawing funds from a validator and confirming withdrawals via StakingManager
scope.environment: StakingManager contract on Hyperliquid (HYPE native token)

statements.text: Funds are withdrawn from the validator and are to be sent to the StakingManager contract.
confirmWithdrawals must be executed to complete the withdrawal process.
Sending the native token HYPE to the StakingManager contract automatically triggers the stake() function via the receive function, so funds cannot be sent without staking.
The StakingManager contract lacks a payable function that accepts withdrawal funds without triggering staking.
The StakingManager contract must be able to receive native token HYPE withdrawn from the validator without automatically staking it, so that confirmWithdrawals can complete.

ambiguities: Report does not specify a concrete caller or transaction sequence for the withdrawal; the trigger is described conditionally as funds being withdrawn from the validator.
No explicit actor/authorization condition is stated for who initiates the withdrawal or confirmWithdrawals.
